items.label: Completed the CoE backlog priority plan
items.detail: The backlog follow-through is now closed and ready to support Thursday's portfolio discussion.

items.label: Set the Salesforce banner path and addressed the Grievances display issue
items.detail: The banner ownership and display-repair follow-up is now closed.

items.label: Verified the Supabase security warnings through trusted sources
items.detail: The security-warning review is now complete.

items.label: Resolved the disabled Power Automate flow follow-up
items.detail: The affected-flow review and disposition are now complete.

items.label: Reviewed the Jarid coverage plan
items.detail: The coverage review is now complete.

items.label: Finish the active-project accuracy review for Thursday's portfolio meeting
items.detail: Confirm that each active project's status, percentage, target date, and support needs reflect the latest PM updates before the Operations Portfolio Review.

items.label: Re-hide the DACA renewal tasksets in Litify
items.detail: The paused tasksets were confirmed live in production. Submit the Halo ticket, reference the prior agreement, and verify that both processes are hidden again.

items.label: Close the remaining Amazon Connect routing questions
items.detail: Confirm whether the queue should use the alias or contact-flow version and determine whether Phase 1 and Phase 2 Operations belong in Wave 4.

items.label: Review Astrid's batch of project access requests
items.detail: A large set of access requests arrived late in the day across Litify taskset, matter-plan, automation, and related project work. Review and approve or route them together where possible.

items.label: The MHE Expansion touchpoint moved to an async update
items.detail: Today's meeting was replaced by a written status update. The update confirmed the project is moving forward, with the pilot planned for November 20 and go-live planned for January 5, 2027.

items.label: Personal work folders will not remain in the official EPMO portfolio
items.detail: The team aligned that personal PM and project-coordinator workspaces should be unlinked from the portfolio while remaining available to their owners if needed.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup; 11:30 AM - Armando 1:1
items.detail: Carry forward only the unresolved routing, testing, or ownership decisions, then use the 1:1 for a focused follow-up.

items.label: Noon - Operations Portfolio Review
items.detail: Bring the current CoE backlog view, verified project updates, named owners, launch risks, and decisions that need portfolio-level support.

items.label: 1:30 PM - Sprint 21 prioritization
items.detail: Enter with the ranked work and capacity tradeoffs clear after the portfolio review.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Tudo Bem! weekly meeting
items.detail: Use the protected 3:00 PM block to prepare a concise update on outcomes, risks, and next owners.
